analysis.scoreReason: RSI 중립 구간 횡보, MACD 개선 미약
analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI neutral range, MACD slight improvement
analysis.reason: 최근 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 탈출 후 중립 구간에서 횡보 중이며, MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 추세 전환을 확정하기에는 미약. 거래량도 5일 평균 대비 0.68배로 위축되어 방향성 부재. 53,260원 현재가는 스윙 지지선 51,065원과 저항선 65,285원 사이에서 횡보 중. ADX 30.0으로 뚜렷한 추세는 형성되었으나, +DI 20.6 대비 -DI 32.5로 하락 압력이 우위. 따라서 추가적인 지표 확인 전까지 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive trading day. RSI has exited oversold territory and is now consolidating in the neutral zone, while the MACD histogram shows slight improvement but is not yet conclusive for a trend reversal. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.68x the 5-day average, indicating a lack of directional conviction. The current price of 53,260 KRW is trading sideways between the swing support at 51,065 KRW and resistance at 65,285 KRW. ADX at 30.0 suggests a clear trend, but the -DI at 32.5 is stronger than the +DI at 20.6, indicating downward pressure. Therefore, maintaining a cautious stance until further indicator confirmation.

analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly RSI at 35.8 indicates weakness, but daily RSI at 39.2 has exited oversold and entered the neutral zone. Daily indicators take precedence.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (53,260 KRW) vs SMA5 (52,041 KRW) / SMA20 (61,388 KRW) / SMA50 (81,384 KRW): trading above short-term trend, below mid-term trend
· Significantly below SMA100 (99,392 KRW) / SMA200 (112,434 KRW): indicating strong mid-to-long-term downtrend
· 52-week position (7.1%): current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (32.5→39.2): exiting oversold, continuing in neutral zone, weak upward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (3.0720→254.1277): improving, early signal of exiting bearish convergence
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band 61,388 KRW): trading around the mid-band, 63.23% band width suggests potential for increased volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (51,065 KRW): based on 5-day/20-day lows, key defense line on downside
· Swing resistance (65,285 KRW): based on 5-day/20-day highs, potential trend reversal if broken on upside
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: 5-day low > 20-day low, 5-day high < 20-day high → diagnosing a sideways phase
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.68x): subdued compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movements
· Current phase diagnosis: potential accumulation phase, consider buying upon meeting entry conditions after further indicator confirmation
